# dsh-api-balance
> DeepSeek Harness 内置余额显示 · npm: `dsh-api-balance-plugin`

A DeepSeek Harness **plugin bundle** that keeps your DeepSeek
API balance in sight: a resident pill

under the composer, a click-through detail popover, a `/balance` command,
and an `api_balance` tool
the agent can call on its own.
> This is a Harness plugin (a Host half + a browser half + a bundle patch), not a model-facing skill

.
> Installing it adds real UI and a real tool to the Harness; a skill only adds instructions to the
alling it adds real UI and a real tool to the Harness; a skill only adds instructions to the prompt.
中文说明 · Install · Configuration · How it works · Privacy · Limitations
## Features
- **Resident pill** in the composer dock, beside the built-in activity and usage entries: `¥128.40`.

It refreshes on
its own and never needs a click to stay current.
- **Detail popover** on click: tot

al balance, topped-up credit, granted credit, the update time, and links to the
Platform pages for u

sage detail and top-up.
- **`/balance` command**: type it in the composer and the balance lands in t

he conversation as a plain text row.
Nothing is sent to the model and no tokens are spent.
- **`api_

balance` tool**: ask the agent “how much credit is left?” and it reads the same values.
- **Both cre

dential styles**: a signed-in DeepSeek account (wallet balances from the account grant) or a plain
`

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. It picks whichever you actually have.
- **Theme- and locale-aware**: only `--dsw-

alias-*` tokens are used, and the copy follows the active UI language
(English and Chinese are bundl

s-*` tokens are used, and the copy follows the active UI language
(English and Chinese are bundled).
## Requirements
| Requirement | Notes |

| DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` | Tested against `0.2.1-rc.2` (desktop and web). |
| A credential

| A signed-in DeepSeek account in the app, or the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential reference. |
| A De
epSeek account | Other providers do not expose a balance endpoint; see Limitations. |
## Install
**From npm** — ask your agent:
> Install the `dsh-api-balance-plugin` plugin bundle.
That runs Plugin Manager's `install_bundle` with the package name, links it into your profile, and e

nables it; the app's
**Settings → Plugins** area accepts the same name. Reinstalling the package is
how an upgrade lands.
**From this repository** — clone it and install the directory (handy while trying a local change):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
> Install the plugin bundle at `<absolute path>/dsh-api-balance`.
Both routes survive restarts because the bundle is recorded in your profile, not in a session.
## Configuration
Two knobs, both with safe defaults. Override them by targeting the row id `api-balance` in your prof

ile patch layer
(`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`). A matching override replaces the **w

hole** config, so repeat every
key you still want:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `refreshSeconds` | `60` | How often the Host re-reads the balance (clamped to 15–3600). The pill p

olls the Host at the same rate. |
| `lowBalance` | `5` | Below this amount the pill switches to the
warning tone and the popover adds a low-balance note. `0` disables it. |
## Usage
| Surface | What happens |
| Composer dock | `¥128.40` with a state dot. Green = available, amber = low balance or a failed rea

d, grey = unavailable. |
| Click the pill | Popover with `总余额 / 充值 / 赠送`, update time, `用量明细` and `去

充值` links, plus an `Esc`-to-close dialog and a manual refresh button. |
| `/balance` | A command row

with the same numbers; errors (no credential, 401, timeout) print their reason. |
| Agent tool | `a
pi_balance` with an optional `fresh` flag to bypass the Host cache. |
The popover reads through the Host, so the API key never reaches the browser: the page only ever see
r reads through the Host, so the API key never reaches the browser: the page only ever sees amounts.
## Data & privacy
- The Host reads `ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance()` when an account grant is stored; otherwise it re

solves the
`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential reference (provider store first, then the ambient environme

nt) and calls
`GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`.
- The browser receives a JSON snapshot of

**amounts only** — no token, no key, no profile.
- The snapshot route is `GET /plugin/api-balance/s

napshot`, same-origin guarded (a cross-site `sec-fetch-site`
is answered with 403; other methods get

405). It is registered on the local Harness web server only.
- The Host caches one snapshot for `re

freshSeconds` so several surfaces never multiply upstream calls.
- Nothing is written to disk by thi
s plugin; it keeps no history and sends no telemetry.
## Limitations
- **DeepSeek only.** The plugin reads the DeepSeek Platform wallet. OpenAI, Anthropic and most other

providers do not
publish a balance endpoint, so a generic “balance” panel is not something one adap

ter can cover.
- **Balance, not itemized usage.** The public API exposes the wallet, not a usage led

ger, so “usage detail” is a link
into the Platform page where you are already signed in.
- **Sign-in
happens in the app.** If you use an API key, that is all the plugin needs. Account wallets only app

ear when
the Harness account sign-in is complete.
- The pill needs a Web-surface client (the compose

r dock is a browser slot); `/balance` and the tool are Host-side and
work wherever a composer or an

rowser slot); `/balance` and the tool are Host-side and
work wherever a composer or an agent exists.
## How it works
| File | Role |
| `index.js` | Host half: one `read()` shared by the HTTP route, the `/balance` command and the `api

_balance` tool, with a TTL cache and upstream failure reporting. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: a `
conversation.composer.dock` entry that renders the pill and a fixed-position popover, polls the rout

e, and follows `ctx.locale`. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch: inserts row `api-balance` with i

ts default config. |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | Plugin Manager title and description. |
| `icon.svg`
| Original artwork (circle + `¥`), no third-party assets. |

Registration points: `ctx.webServer.register`, `ctx.commands.register`, `ctx.tools.register`,
`ctx.s
lots.inject('conversation.composer.dock')`. Everything is registered through `ctx.inject`/`ctx.effec

t`, so
disabling the bundle removes the route, the command, the tool and the pill together.
